suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as complication outcome risk. Require established Charcot neuropathic arthropathy and documented limb loss/amputation outcome; preserve laterality and underlying neuropathy/vascular/infectious contributors. Amputation is a possible adverse outcome, not an inevitable complication. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Charcot Neuropathic Arthropathy and Amputation / Loss of Use of Limbs or Digits
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
